_comment: Demo profile: a FICTIONAL candidate (no real person, employer or school). Shows the tool on a small, realistic repository.
name: Casey Sample

evidence.claim: Automated shipment reports in Python and Excel, saving 10 hrs per week.
evidence.brief: automated weekly shipment reports in Python and Excel

evidence.claim: Analysed supply chain data for 5 warehouses with stakeholders in operations.
evidence.brief: analysed supply chain data across 5 warehouses

evidence.claim: Owned the checkout roadmap and wrote PRDs with acceptance criteria for 3 squads.
evidence.brief: owned the checkout roadmap and wrote PRDs for 3 squads

evidence.claim: Ran 12 A/B tests on checkout and shipped guest checkout, lifting conversion 6%.
evidence.brief: ran 12 checkout A/B tests and shipped guest checkout

evidence.claim: Ran product discovery with 40 customer interviews and prioritized the backlog in Jira.
evidence.brief: ran product discovery with 40 customer interviews

evidence.claim: Built SQL dashboards in Tableau used in weekly business reviews.
evidence.brief: built SQL dashboards in Tableau for weekly business reviews

evidence.claim: Launched UPI payment retries with the gateway team, cutting failed payments 8%.
evidence.brief: launched UPI payment retries that cut failed payments 8%

evidence.claim: Set up Mixpanel funnels for the checkout team to track drop-off by step.
evidence.brief: set up Mixpanel funnels to track checkout drop-off

evidence.claim: Prototyped the new checkout flow in Figma and tested it with 8 users before build.
evidence.brief: prototyped a checkout flow in Figma and tested it with 8 users

forbiddenClaims.pattern: people manag|team lead|led a team|managed a team|direct reports|manage a team
forbiddenClaims.message: No people management: the demo candidate has never managed a team.

bridges.payments: Point to the UPI payment-retry launch and how you would ramp up on cards and settlements.
bridges.martech: Say plainly you have not run lifecycle campaigns; offer the checkout experiments as the closest work.

probes.question: Have you managed people?
probes.bridge: No direct reports; I coordinated 3 squads through PRDs and reviews.

probes.question: Tell us about an experiment that changed your roadmap.
probes.bridge: Guest checkout: 12 A/B tests, +6% conversion, then reprioritized the backlog.

probes.question: How do you run discovery?
probes.bridge: 40 customer interviews, a clustered problem list, then a prioritized backlog in Jira.

followUpTemplate: Hi {name}, I applied for the {role} role at {company} earlier and noticed it again. I'm still very interested: {hook}. Happy to share a short work sample if useful.

whyRoleTemplates.opening: I want the {role} role at {company} because it matches work I have already done.
whyRoleTemplates.closing: I'd bring the same ownership to {company}: start from the user's problem, set a clear quality bar, and ship in small, measurable steps.
